title: PostToolUse output
description: Adds a note next to the result or replaces what the model sees. The tool has already run. Top level open for Claude Code compatibility (same reason as hookSpecificOutput): unknown fields are ignored.

decision.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:2230). Only value: "block". Adds `reason` next to the result; the model still sees the original output.

reason.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:2231). Note added next to the result.

hookSpecificOutput.description: Event-specific output. Open for Claude Code compatibility: Claude Code adds fields here across versions, and a script shared with Claude Code must not be rejected by Zed for a field Zed does not know. Unknown fields are ignored.

hookEventName.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1064). Must be this event name; in Zed a mismatch is a hook failure.

additionalContext.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1305). Text added to the model context.

updatedToolOutput.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:2234) name. Replaces what the model sees; must follow the Zed ToolResponse shape.
